svg.title: Producer map: the hello program's records by producer stage, after a body edit and after a comment edit
svg.desc: Columns are the producer stages in rank order, from Discover to NativeInterface; Layout, Default, MutationEffect and Instance hold no record of the hello program. Rows are the app namespace and the functions greeting and main; a band on the left holds the frozen admitted record runtime-facade(println_text). One discover(app) evaluation reads the captured source and outputs a declaration source, doc record and position map per function. Typed reads point from reader to target: P present, M members, A absent. In the body edit, where "hello" becomes "hullo", discover, greeting's declaration source, influence, local, final, Body IR chain and plan function, and native-interface are evaluated; influence(greeting) stays equal, so slot(greeting) and declaration(greeting) are reused; local(main) read only name-slot(greeting) and slot(greeting), so nothing of main is evaluated; native-interface reads the changed plan root. In the comment edit, a comment above main, only discover, position-map(main) and native-interface are evaluated. Insets show a joint group, one mutation-effect evaluation for two functions that forward to each other, publishing each member under its own key, and an absent witness at helpers.f held by name-slot(app, f), whose reader evaluates when helpers.incn is created.
svg.text: PRODUCER STAGES IN RANK ORDER · NAMESPACE, STAGE, GROUP

g.text: influence(greeting) reads the changed body and is evaluated; its value is equal, so slot(greeting) and declaration(greeting) are reused.
local(main) read only name-slot(greeting) and slot(greeting), so main evaluates nothing; native-interface(app) reads a changed plan root, and the unit is baked again, whole.
Header seeds and body projections are equal, so every semantic record is reused; position-map(main) changes, and native-interface(app) reads it for the line tables.
INSET · A JOINT GROUP OF TWO FUNCTIONS
One evaluation runs the fixed point; each member publishes under its own key.
exact slot · selection context · exclusion digest
Creating helpers.incn puts a record at helpers.f, so name-slot(app, f) evaluates;
unrelated modules and unrelated new siblings do not.

svg.text: every read points from reader to target
